description: Attach pwa-debug to a page on an Android phone in one call: finds the phone over adb, forwards its browser's DevTools socket, optionally exposes desktop ports to the phone (reverse_ports, so http://localhost:<port> works there), then attaches to an open tab (url_contains / target_id / the only one) or opens a new tab at open_url. Returns a connection id to pass as extension_id to every other pwa-debug tool, so framework, store, PWA, interaction, evaluate, navigation and console/network/error capture all work on the phone. Args: { serial?, socket?, open_url?, url_contains?, target_id?, reload?, reverse_ports? }.

open_url.description: Open a new tab at this URL on the phone and attach it (bridge present before the page loads).

reload.description: Reload the attached tab so the bridge runs before the app code.

reverse_ports.description: Desktop ports to expose on the phone as localhost:<port> (adb reverse), e.g. [5173] for a dev server.

serial.description: Device serial from pdl_android_devices; optional when one phone is connected.

socket.description: DevTools socket name, "chrome", "webview", or an app package. Default: Chrome.

target_id.description: Attach to this tab id (or prefix).

url_contains.description: Attach to the open tab whose URL contains this text.

name: pdl_android_attach
